name: Days Launch
conditions: Free $0 plan requires a backlink to dayslaunch.com on your site.
Free tier is throttled: 'Reviewed only 5 listed every day' — a daily listing quota creates a queue.
requirements: Product/tool listings; the site is a Mkdirs-boilerplate directory with categories, collections, and tags.
Account required: /submit redirects to a login page (email/password plus Google and GitHub OAuth).
preparation: Backlink to dayslaunch.com live on your site for the free plan.
Plan choice: free $0 (backlink, ~5 listings/day cap) / pro $9.9 (no backlink, list right now, featured top placement, social+newsletter share) / sponsor $19.9/week.
workflow: Go to https://dayslaunch.com/submit — register/log in first.
Free: with the backlink live, wait for review — only ~5 free listings publish per day.
Pro: 'list right now, publish whenever you want' with featured placement.
watchFor: Daily cap on free listings ('only 5 listed every day') creates a real queue — pro's instant listing is the counter-upsell.
'Permanent link with backlink maintenance' — free listing likely conditioned on the backlink persisting.
Identical pricing copy to aibesttop.com and collectai.tools — shared boilerplate; verify any specific promises on this site itself.
Heavy badge/bek link exchange farm visible in footer — directory-of-directories economics.
countsAsLive: A public item page on dayslaunch.com visible under Explore/categories while logged out.
unknowns: Exact submit form fields behind login.
Real free-queue wait given the 5/day cap.
